arStrings.szText: Aye…aye, that we will. I just wish I had—
(grunt) Damn it! Will you shut up?!
Agitated. He is hearing voices from the Tree of Whispers in his head, and he can't take it anymore--he snaps at them.
Sorry. It’s...our old friend the Tree of Whispers. Ever since I stepped foot in the swamp, I can hear the voices.
Taking a moment to compose himself, then explaining why he snapped.
They know what we’re up against, they can feel it. A change in the bones of the world. A storm on the horizon.
Trying to act like he's all right, but inside he feels guilty about what happened to Neyrelle.
Trying to act like he's all right, but inside he feels guilty about what happened to Neyrelle.
They can kiss my arse—we have a Prime Evil to hunt. And we need to be prepared.
Trying to act like he's all right, but inside he feels guilty about what happened to Neyrelle.
Here. I made this talisman to help Neyrelle. I hope it did...in some way. But it's yours now, for whatever awaits us.
Lorath hands a Horadric talisman to the Player. A magical amulet that they can use to protect themselves.
